# HDC pull request checklist

## Change and validation
- [ ] Exact modified files and baseline SHA recorded.
- [ ] Native-workspace/static and browser QA performed where applicable.
- [ ] No unrelated files deleted, moved, or renamed.
- [ ] Human merge permission obtained separately.

## 🔴 Zero-cost impact (MANDATORY)
- **Incremental cost:** `PKR 0 / UNKNOWN / POSSIBLY PAID`
- **New vendor, payment, license, paid API, quota, account or tier:** `none / details`
- **Existing free/paid-included quota checked (source and date):**
- **Free alternatives evaluated (minimum two if paid option proposed):**
- **Usage/overage ceiling and fallback:**
- **Billing changes:** `NONE / BLOCKED`
- **Three separate administrator approvals:** `NOT APPLICABLE / BLOCKED`
- **Post-approval audit email confirmed sent:** `NOT APPLICABLE / BLOCKED`

> If cost status is UNKNOWN or POSSIBLY PAID, stop all spending-enabling actions. A merged code change does not authorize a purchase. See `docs/HDC_ZERO_COST_GOVERNANCE_2026-10-22.md`.
